traits_detailed.Medium: Elves are Medium creatures and have no bonuses or penalties due to their size
traits_detailed.Normal Speed: Elves have a base speed of 30 feet
traits_detailed.Low-Light Vision: Elves can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light
traits_detailed.Elven Immunities: Elves are immune to magic sleep effects and get a +2 racial bonus on saving throws against enchantment spells and effects
traits_detailed.Elven Magic: Elves receive a +2 racial bonus on caster level checks made to overcome spell resistance
traits_detailed.Keen Senses: Elves receive a +2 racial bonus on Perception checks
traits_detailed.Weapon Familiarity: Elves are proficient with longbows (including composite longbows), longswords, rapiers, and shortbows (including composite shortbows), and treat any weapon with the word “elven” in its name as a martial weapon
